title: Light cone of an affine chart
html: Consider an open subset U \subset M_0 representing a portion of the descended universe between two regime boundaries. An affine chart on U is a local coordinate patch in which the metric on the base manifold M_0 defines a causal structure. The light cone of the affine chart forms the boundary of the causal future in U. The metric on M_0 determines this light cone, which ensures no singularity of the ambient space is visible from within the chart. In this way, the affine chart provides a non-singular window onto a portion of the Descartes universe.
